from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When set, the path must have exactly as many segments as the pattern, so a
    # star stands for one directory. Host routes keep separator-spanning stars (MEDIA-731).
    same_depth: bool = False


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", same_depth=True),)
EOF

def test_default_badge_route_does_not_expose_nested_folders():
    service = AssetService({
        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
    })
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/badge.png") == (200, b"PNG")
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")[0] == 403
    assert not service.is_public("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")


def test_host_routes_keep_separator_spanning_stars():
    from src.routes import PublicRoute

    service = AssetService({"/partners/a/b/logo.png": b"L"}, routes=(PublicRoute("/partners/*/logo.png"),))
    assert service.fetch("/partners/a/b/logo.png") == (200, b"L")
EOF
